claims.label: Harpole Claims He Cut Charlie Kirk's Shirt Off at Hospital
claims.claim: Brian Harpole states in the Sean Ryan interview that he personally cut Charlie Kirk's white "freedom shirt" off at the hospital.
claims.investigative_direction: Obtain Sean Ryan show audio/video; cross-reference against hospital records, gurney handling logs, and ER staff testimony to verify or falsify Harpole's account.

claims.label: Sarah Tool's First Interview Asserted Shot to Heart
claims.claim: In her first Fox 13 interview, Sarah Tool stated that Charlie Kirk was shot directly in the heart from her right side, with a single shot.
claims.investigative_direction: Obtain original Fox 13 footage; verify timestamp and quoted language against Sarah Tool's subsequent statements.

claims.label: Sarah Tool's Second Interview Asserted Shot to Neck
claims.claim: Approximately 51 minutes after her first interview, Sarah Tool stated in local media that Charlie Kirk was shot in the neck.
claims.investigative_direction: Obtain original local-media footage and timestamp; document any prompts or interviewer framing that may have influenced the revised account.

claims.label: Sarah Tool's ABC Interview Asserted Shooter at ~200 Yards
claims.claim: In her ABC News interview, Sarah Tool stated the shooter was approximately 200 yards away and that the shot struck Charlie Kirk in the left side of the neck.
claims.investigative_direction: Verify the 200-yard figure against the documented distance from the Loews Center to the courtyard; check ABC News raw footage for prior coaching or scripting cues.

claims.label: Judge Graff Denied Motion to Compel Lance Twiggs In-Person Testimony
claims.claim: Judge Graff has denied the defense motion to compel Lance Twiggs to appear in person at the preliminary hearing scheduled for the week of July 6.
claims.investigative_direction: Obtain the underlying court order from Utah state court records to verify the ruling, its date, and its specific findings.

claims.label: Lance Twiggs Testimony Admitted as Recorded Statement
claims.claim: Under the ruling, Lance Twiggs's testimony against Tyler Robinson will be presented at the preliminary hearing as a recorded statement rather than live testimony.
claims.investigative_direction: Obtain the preliminary-hearing scheduling order and any associated evidentiary rulings to confirm the recorded-statement procedure and the recorded-statement transcript.

claims.label: Viewer Email Identifies White Markings on SUV Shards Consistent with Rode Mic
claims.claim: A viewer email asserts that white markings visible on the SUV floorboard shards match the design and labeling on a Rode Wireless Pro microphone.
claims.investigative_direction: Preserve viewer email as a tip lead; pursue forensic comparison of shard imagery with manufacturer specifications and any recovered physical shard fragments.

claims.label: Enhanced SUV Shard Images Show White Markings Matching Rode Mic Design
claims.claim: Enhanced still images displayed on the show show white markings on the SUV floorboard shards that visually align with Rode Wireless Pro body design and labeling.
claims.investigative_direction: Source original high-resolution images from John Bray or other collectors; submit for independent forensic image analysis.

claims.label: Rode Wireless Pro Destruction Video Produces Comparable Shard Pattern
claims.claim: A YouTube video showing a third party destroying a Rode Wireless Pro produces a shard pattern that visually resembles the shards seen on the SUV floorboard.
claims.investigative_direction: Preserve the YouTube source video as comparison reference; identify original video uploader and timestamp; pursue additional independent destruction tests with documented methodology.

claims.label: Erika Kirk's Signature Changed Dramatically Between Miss Arizona Era and Current
claims.claim: Signatures displayed on the show show Erika's current signature as visually distinct from her Miss Arizona era signature.
claims.investigative_direction: Obtain original Miss Arizona-era signed documents from 2004-2007 competition records and notarized documents from current TPUSA / personal filings for forensic handwriting comparison.
